dog.description_text:
Meet Sevyn, a gorgeous young dog from NYC Animal Care Center. Sevyn has been living it up in a foster home with 3 other dogs for the last few months, and his foster dad has really helped him blossom. He is an active, healthy young dog who enjoys the company of other canines and loves people. He's got the charm, the looks, and the brains. He's a rambunctious player, so a home without little ones would be best. Sevyn is house trained, calm in his crate, and a good walking buddy. If you're ready for a loyal partner, Sevyn is your boy! Submit an application today to learn more about how you can bring Sevyn home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
